votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes of June 14, 2022
votes.description: The Board approved the official meeting minutes from the June 14, 2022 RDA meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 9 of 2022 Housing Development Loan Program – Emergency Gap Funding Allocations
votes.description: The Board adopted a resolution approving $3 million in Emergency Gap Financing funding allocations through the Housing Development Loan Program (HDLP) to support affordable housing development projects.

The Board approved the consent agenda, which included setting a public hearing date for RDA Budget Amendment No. 1 for FY 2022-23, and approving appointments of Baxter Reecer, Amy Rowland, and the re-appointment of Brian Doughty to the Redevelopment Advisory Committee.
